Rules.Name: Holo Deterrence Field
Rules.Text: At the end of this Ship's activation, choose two different Arcs from F/SL/SR/R. Until the start of this Ship's next activation, enemy Launch Assets that start their move within 6" in the chosen Arcs reduce their Thrust by 2" for that move and cannot be placed in base contact with this Ship.

Rules.Name: Feature Carrier
Rules.Text: When building your fleet, this Ship must be assigned a Deployable Feature from the PHR Deployable Features list, paying points for this Feature. This Ship starts the game carrying that Deployable Feature.
